extracted.name: The Famous Seafood Seasoning Recipe
extracted.description: This homemade seafood seasoning blend goes with all sorts of seafood dishes, plus salads, and poultry dishes too. It tastes just like store-bought.
instruction_lines: Mix salt, celery seed, mustard powder, red pepper flakes, black pepper, bay leaves, paprika, cloves, allspice, ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.
